python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs_0036:
# Pose 36: pos=(0.5, 3.3), heading=0.0 (facing +y)
# Here chair_2 is clearly visible on the right!
img36 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0036.png')

# Chair 2 legs in obs 36:
# Find bottom of legs of chair 2 (x > 400)
c2_mask = (img36[:,:,2] > 50) & (img36[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 400)
ys, xs = np.where(c2_mask)
print('Chair 2 in obs 36: xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())

# Find the leg contact rows
# Left front leg: col ~ 430
# Right front leg: col ~ 475
for y in range(350, 420):
    if not (img36[y, 437, 2] > 50 and img36[y, 437, 0] < 50):
        print('Chair 2 left leg bottom at y=', y-1)
        break

for y in range(350, 420):
    if not (img36[y, 508, 2] > 50 and img36[y, 508, 0] < 50):
        print('Chair 2 right leg bottom at y=', y-1)
        break

for y in range(350, 420):
    if not (img36[y, 470, 2] > 50 and img36[y, 470, 0] < 50):
        print('Chair 2 middle leg bottom at y=', y-1)
        break
"
